header.title: User Identifier Setting
header.description: Choose how users are uniquely identified when registering or logging in to your institute. This affects how duplicate accounts are detected during enrollment.

email.label: Email Address
email.description: Users are identified by their email. Two users with the same email are treated as the same person across enrollments.

phone.label: Phone Number
phone.description: Users are identified by their mobile number. Use this when learners register without email or when phone is the primary login method for your institute.
